common: Use case: stylized-concept. Lumia Chronicles original warm academic classical fantasy game asset. Fine hand drawn ink outlines, soft watercolor and colored pencil matte texture, cream parchment, sage green, restrained coral and antique brass, quiet turquoise rune light. Cohesive readable game art, no logos, no words, no letters, no UI text, no watermark, no scenery unless specifically a tile/backdrop, no border unless requested. No photorealism, plastic 3D, neon, excessive ornate gold. One asset only. Full object visible, clean contour, appropriate breathing room. Transparent background when requested, fully opaque object interiors except intentional glass/glow.

assets.name: 양피지_타일
assets.delta: Seamless tileable very pale cream parchment texture, evenly lit, low contrast, no edges, no stains, no vignette, no ornaments, no writing, flat front view fills square edge to edge.

assets.name: 프레임_모서리
assets.delta: Single restrained upper-left L-shaped frame corner ornament, sage leaves and two tiny cream flowers around one thin antique brass curved line. Decoration only in top-left elbow extending right and down, open empty remainder, no whole frame. Front view, transparent.

assets.name: 캐릭터_카드_배경
assets.delta: Portrait card BACKDROP only. Pale cream center with softly brushed sage wash on lower corners, tiny leaf sprigs at extreme corners. Empty calm center for full-body character overlay. No character, no frame, no text. Edge-to-edge opaque.

assets.name: 전신_미리보기_배경
assets.delta: Portrait background, softly lit shallow cream stone arch niche in Arcadia academy, muted sage ivy only at outer edges, simple pale flat floor low at base. Center extremely calm low contrast for character overlay, no characters or furniture, opaque full bleed.

assets.name: 입학_초대장
assets.delta: Landscape admission invitation blank parchment sheet seen straight-on, entire sheet centered on transparent background, 8% outer margin. Warm cream handmade paper, small sage botanical corners, very thin restrained brass line decoration, tiny blank wax seal at lower edge. Wide perfectly blank writing area. NO text, no letters, no fake runic writing.
